oracleSource: Actual old PR working-tree file, not the frozen FORMAT2 source trees.

method.currentReferenceFixture: Fresh current buildAuthoringFixture per case plus the unchanged complete saved target.
method.availableSavedReferences: Replace only known seeded paths with unchanged saved bytes where present; enumerate missing references; never invent complete historical worktrees.
method.format2Comparability: The available-saved-references v3 result must exactly JSON.stringify-match original summary.quality. Otherwise both modes are UNKNOWN and v4 is diagnostic only.
method.limits: No process/trajectory/semantic regrade, no model calls, no new evals, no original grades overwritten. Historical 34 rows are artifact-only offline probes.
